title: pvNek5000Reader
body:
## pvNek5000Reader

Reads Nek5000 spectral-element results through a .nek5000 metadata file that names the field-file template and the time steps. The output is an unstructured grid built from each spectral element's nodal points, with the selected fields as point arrays. Each element keeps its own copy of points shared with its neighbours unless MergePointstoCleangrid is enabled. This is a distributed reader.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Without MergePointstoCleangrid neighbouring elements are not connected, so connectivity-based steps (surface extraction, connectivity) may see internal faces; merging fixes this but may use a lot of memory.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `Nek5000Reader`. Identity: `sources/Nek5000Reader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AddSpectralElementIdsasCellData` | Add Spectral Element Ids as cell-data (optional) | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `MergePointstoCleangrid` | Clean the dataset by merging coincident points. May use a lot of memory. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PointArrays` | This property lists which point-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvNek5000Reader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
